_comment: PII linter hook for Zed editor (agent panel).
Install: `pii-lint install-hooks zed` merges this into
post_tool_use: after Zed's agent writes/edits a buffer, scan it.
$ZED_TOOL_FILE_PATH is set by Zed's hook runtime.
Exit 2 on HIGH+ so Zed surfaces the report and
Stop:          at end-of-session, scan the staged diff. Exit 2
forces a cleanup pass before final save.

hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$ZED_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pii-lint scan -- "$f" || exit 2;; esac'
